title: Unraveling the molecular Nexus of Alzheimer's Disease and HIV encephalitis: The role of cellular senescence and transcriptional regulation.
authors: Zhang, Hao; Chen, WenJun; Yuan, ShuYou; Ding, ShaoXiang; Bao, HongXia; Cai, Bo; Sun, JunKai; Lu, Wei; Zhu, HaoGang; Shi, GuoXun
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用机器学习整合转录组数据识别AD和HAND的交叉诊断生物标志物（FOXO3、STAT3、ZNF341），虽涉及转录因子表达与调控，但核心是疾病诊断与通路富集，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模或结合机制研究，方法上仅用传统机器学习分类，无AI结构建模或物理模拟。
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) and HIV-associated neurocognitive disorder (HAND) share progressive cognitive decline. Their common molecular mechanisms remain poorly understood. Current therapeutic approaches lack effective biomarkers for early diagnosis and intervention. We integrated transcriptomic profiles from multiple independent cohorts across brain tissues and blood. We systematically evaluated diagnostic performance using machine learning algorithms including Random Forest, Support Vector Machine, and XGBoost. Notably, FOXO3 emerged as the top cross-disease biomarker. FOXO3 achieved diagnostic accuracy in AD temporal cortex (area under the curve [AUC] = 0.922, 95% CI: 0.885-0.959). FOXO3 showed diagnostic performance in HAND frontal cortex (AUC = 0.771, 95% CI: 0.724-0.818). FOXO3 expression positively correlated with APP (R = 0.558). FOXO3 expression negatively correlated with MAPT (R = -0.690) and SORL1 (R = -0.856). ACE showed strong positive correlation with FOXO3 (R = 0.685), suggesting vascular involvement. STAT3 and ZNF341 were identified from 21 transcription factor candidates. STAT3 ranked first in HAND integrated cohort (n = 107, AUC = 0.759). STAT3 may function as an inflammatory mediator through JAK-STAT signaling. ZNF341 showed strongest transcriptional association with disease status (beta = 5.09 in AD, beta = 4.85 in HAND). The two-gene panel (FOXO3-ZNF341) achieved diagnostic accuracy in blood samples (AUC = 0.764, n = 329). This performance approaches clinical utility thresholds. Blood-based detection offers non-invasive diagnostic potential. Saturation analysis identified three molecules as optimal panel size. Marginal AUC gains declined below 0.02 beyond this threshold. FOXO3, STAT3, and ZNF341 showed stable selection frequency (97%, 65%, and 100%, respectively). PI3K-Akt and FoxO signaling pathways were enriched, which are known to regulate apoptosis and cell survival. Taken together, these computational findings indicate FOXO3 transcriptional regulatory activity in neurodegeneration. The three-molecule panel represents candidate blood-based diagnostic biomarkers. These candidate biomarkers warrant further investigation in independent clinical cohorts.
abstract_zh: 阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's disease, AD）和HIV相关神经认知障碍（HIV-associated neurocognitive disorder, HAND）共同表现为进行性认知衰退。其共同分子机制仍知之甚少。当前治疗方法缺乏用于早期诊断和干预的有效生物标志物。我们整合了来自多个独立队列的脑组织和血液转录组谱。我们使用包括随机森林（Random Forest）、支持向量机（Support Vector Machine）和XGBoost在内的机器学习算法系统评估了诊断性能。值得注意的是，FOXO3成为跨疾病的首要生物标志物。FOXO3在AD颞叶皮层中达到诊断准确性（曲线下面积 [AUC] = 0.922，95% CI: 0.885-0.959）。FOXO3在HAND额叶皮层中显示出诊断性能（AUC = 0.771，95% CI: 0.724-0.818）。FOXO3表达与APP呈正相关（R = 0.558）。FOXO3表达与MAPT（R = -0.690）和SORL1（R = -0.856）呈负相关。ACE与FOXO3呈强正相关（R = 0.685），提示血管参与。从21个转录因子候选者中鉴定出STAT3和ZNF341。STAT3在HAND整合队列中排名第一（n = 107，AUC = 0.759）。STAT3可能通过JAK-STAT信号通路作为炎症介质发挥作用。ZNF341与疾病状态显示出最强的转录关联（AD中beta = 5.09，HAND中beta = 4.85）。双基因组合（FOXO3-ZNF341）在血液样本中达到诊断准确性（AUC = 0.764，n = 329）。该性能接近临床实用性阈值。基于血液的检测提供了非侵入性诊断潜力。饱和分析确定三个分子为最佳组合规模。超过此阈值后，边际AUC增益下降至0.02以下。FOXO3、STAT3和ZNF341显示出稳定的选择频率（分别为97%、65%和100%）。PI3K-Akt和FoxO信号通路富集，这些通路已知调控细胞凋亡和细胞存活。综合来看，这些计算发现表明FOXO3在神经退行性变中的转录调控活性。三分子组合代表了候选的基于血液的诊断生物标志物。这些候选生物标志物值得在独立临床队列中进一步研究。
